day_shape: 83 items: CENTCOM says it downed Iranian drones targeting Hormuz shipping and reports 139 vessels redirected under the Iran blockade, US-Iran MoU reported close with UAE unfreezing billions, IDF claims 10+ Hezbollah field commanders killed and issues fresh south-Lebanon evacuation warnings, heavy regime-channel volume, nothing from UK Parliament.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU and uranium pathway
threads.summary: Multiple reports said a US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding is close to being finalised, with a senior US official saying it 'leads to' Washington taking Iran's enriched uranium and Pakistani PM Sharif declaring an agreed text reached. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported FM Araghchi saying the MoU could be signed remotely within days, with nuclear talks to follow an interim deal; CNN reported Trump paused a planned US ground mission to recover uranium.

threads.label: Gulf money and gas-for-restraint reports
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported the UAE has agreed to release billions of dollars to Iran following weeks of Iranian attacks on the Gulf state, and that Qatar offered to cut gas production in exchange for Iran sparing a key facility. Mehr-cited reporting said an initial $12 billion unfreezing and an end to fighting in Lebanon would form part of the full US-Iran ceasefire deal.

threads.label: Hormuz drone interceptions and US blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces shot down multiple Iranian one-way attack drones targeting commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, with traffic continuing unimpeded. CENTCOM also reported its Iran blockade has redirected 139 commercial vessels and disabled 9 non-compliant ships since 13 April.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and evacuation warnings
threads.summary: The IDF said it had killed more than 10 Hezbollah field commanders, including Nasr Unit commander Hajj Salameh and successors Mahdi Bazzi and Ashraf Salloum, and that over 1,300 Hezbollah operatives have been killed since the ceasefire took effect. IDF Arabic spokesman Avichay Adraee issued evacuation orders covering 20 south-Lebanon towns plus Sarafand, Taffah and Mazraat Shina; Times of Israel reported the government is restraining IDF action to avoid derailing US-Iran talks.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone strikes into Israel
threads.summary: The IDF said a suspected Hezbollah drone struck a military zone in northern Israel near the Lebanese border, with no injuries, after sirens sounded in Western Galilee towns. A separate IDF statement said two further suspected Hezbollah drones struck near Israeli forces operating inside southern Lebanon, also without casualties.

threads.label: Gaza strikes on Hamas and PIJ
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed three Palestinian operatives in Thursday strikes in Gaza: PIJ platoon commanders Qasslam Saleh and Sami Abu Dalal and Hamas deputy company commander Ubay Farwana. The military also reported overnight strikes on three Hamas weapons depots in central Gaza storing rocket launchers, mortars, RPGs and explosives.

threads.label: Regime-channel messaging on war and deal
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that 'America's ramshackle bases lack the capacity to even secure themselves,' while Defa Press carried Speaker Qalibaf telling Trump that 'commitments made must be honoured' and a piece cataloguing Trump's '38' claims of an imminent Iran deal. IRIB ran Judiciary chief Ejei saying Iran has 'absolutely no trust in Americans' on the anniversary of the 12-day war, and Defa Press reported the Supreme Leader's pardon of 139 death-row convicts.

events.title: Prediction Markets; Public Interest Determinations
events.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Commission or CFTC) is proposing amendments to its rules concerning event contract derivatives. The markets for these event contracts are commonly referred to as "prediction markets." In particular, the Commission is proposing amendments to further specify the types of event contracts that may be subject to a determination that they are contrary to the public interest, such that they may not be listed for trading or accepted for clearing on or through a CFTC-registered entity, as provided in the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA). The proposed amendments set out factors the Commission would apply in that determination and conform the process by which the determination would be made to the CEA. The Commission also is proposing amendments to the procedure for the Commission's determination to enhance clarity and organization, as well as a definition of the term "gaming" and a rule regarding when event contracts "involve" an underlying activity.
